text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you describe the nature of your flank pain and whether you have any difficulty or burning with urination? Also, when did the fever and fatigue start relative to when you finished your antibiotics for the sinusitis?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any history of kidney stones or recurrent urinary tract infections? I also need to know if you are experiencing nausea, vomiting, or any visible blood in your urine.

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: Did you notice any swelling in your face, hands, or feet, or any changes in the color or amount of your urine while taking the antibiotics? I need to rule out acute interstitial nephritis given the rash and subsequent kidney symptoms.

speaker: Patient
text: I do not have nausea, vomiting, or burning with urination. I also have not noticed a major change in urine color.
